description: Run a full compliance evaluation against a live MCP server URL. Tests: server reachability (ping), manifest discovery (GET /mcp), schema quality (snake_case names, descriptions, inputSchema), JSON-RPC 2.0 test call, and P50/P95 latency. Returns a PASS/FIX/BLOCK verdict with a 0-100 score and per-check details.

test_tool_name.description: Specific tool name to use in the JSON-RPC test call (defaults to the first tool in the manifest)

url.description: Base URL of the MCP server (e.g. https://www.ia-qa.com or http://localhost:3001)

name: mcp_server_evaluate
